::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
**Tool use** extends a language model beyond text generation: the model emits structured calls
to external functions (search, code interpreter, APIs), receives results, and continues reasoning.
The backbone is any instruction-following model; the pattern is model-agnostic.
:::
